DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a Desktop card to the settings page that detects the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and launches it with one click.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0b45375faf41412182f2.html
